subject: Quick favor: short quote + G2 review for NovaScale pilot

Subject: Quick favor: short quote + G2 review for NovaScale pilot

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the pilot over the last six weeks. The results you and the team shared were super helpful and wed love to capture a short customer quote and, if youre comfortable, a brief G2 review so other signal teams can discover the work youve done. Two small asks: 

1) Would you be open to a 15–20 minute call this week for a short case quote we can publish (well share the draft and run it by you for approval)?
2) If a call is a stretch, would you consider leaving a 2–3 sentence review on G2 about the pilot experience?

As a thank-you well send a $50 e-gift (Tango Card) after the review/case quote is live. Ive attached a brief pilot summary that you can reference.

Suggested times: Thu 2/3 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 2/4 09:00–11:30 PT. If none of those work, say when and well accommodate.

Thanks — really appreciate the partnership.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Quick favor: short quote + G2 review for NovaScale pilot

Hi Vivek —

Happy to help — glad the pilot produced useful signals. A couple quick notes from our side before we proceed: 

- Well need Legal to bless any published case study that uses NovaScale branding or deeper operational details. I can get that through, but it may take 48–72 hours.
- For the G2 review, we can post a short customer perspective. We generally prefer mentioning outcomes (latency reduction, developer velocity) rather than specific infra configs.

I can do a 20-minute call on Thu 2/3 at 10:30 PT. If youd like to send a draft quote or example lines ahead of time that would speed Legal review.

Also: how does the $50 e-gift work — procurement needs an external vendor name/version for their records.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
VP, Product Strategy | NovaScale
sarah.jenkins@novascale.io
